resolution: Fixed the module-init cycle my req_1681 fix introduced. Importing the cooked-asset registry (editors/model/cookedAssets) into compile/propRecipes/resolve.ts — an early, very widely-imported module whose prop catalog builds at module-init — created an init-order cycle that left the colors palette (COLORS) undefined when the bed recipe ran during catalog construction, crashing the hmsc-int bundle at eval ('Cannot read properties of undefined (reading blanketSingle)'). Inverted the dependency instead: resolve.ts now exposes registerCookedAssetLookup(fn) and holds a late-bound getter (null until registered); editors/model/cookedAssets registers cookedAssetById at its own module init, the same late-binding pattern the file already uses for registerCookedProps/registerCookedCatalog. resolve.ts no longer statically depends on the heavy cooked-asset module, breaking the cycle; built-in kinds never reach the lookup and a cooked prop is only resolved long after init. Verified: full hmsc-int dev-equivalent bundle now evaluates past the catalog-init crash (only a benign setInterval-undefined remains, an artifact of bare v8cli lacking host timers); build-placed 57/57, worldColliders 6/6, meshProps 1/1, worldGeometry 14/14, worldParity 15/15, cookedAsset 21/21. Committed c2918a61c.
